decisions.what: Replaced existing site-header/site-footer markup with spec's .header/.footer + .logo-container/.social-links/.copyright structure
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requested those class names and internal structure; implementing the spec verbatim per NO ASSUMPTIONS rule

decisions.what: Wrapped edu-card images in with WebP and WebP fallback
decisions.why: Spec allowed either direct .webp swap or <picture> element; used <picture> for progressive enhancement while keeping descriptive alt text on every image

decisions.what: Generated 1x1 WebP files by converting the existing 1x1 JPG placeholders using Pillow at quality 85
decisions.why: Source JPGs in the repo are 1x1 offline placeholders; matched that convention so dimensions and file format stay consistent with the existing pattern documented in the learned context

decisions.what: Extended styles.css with .header, .footer, .footer .social-links, .footer .social-link, .footer .copyright, and small-screen media queries
decisions.why: Spec called for sticky header with logo clear space, dark-purple footer with 48px social circles, light-blue copyright, and final responsive polish
